summary.text: Shawn Harris is the Democratic nominee in Georgia's 14th District. A Georgia native and retired Army brigadier general who began his service in the Marine Corps, he now runs a cattle farm in Polk County. He was the 2024 Democratic nominee against Marjorie Taylor Greene and lost the April 2026 special election runoff to Clayton Fuller.

paragraphs.text: Born in Blakely, Georgia; according to his campaign website, he grew up on his family's farm.
Earned a bachelor's degree in agribusiness from Tuskegee University and a graduate degree in strategic studies from the Army War College.

Enlisted in the U.S. Marine Corps after high school and rose to sergeant, then served in the U.S. Army and retired as a brigadier general after 40 years of military service, according to his campaign website.
Describes deploying as an infantry commander in Afghanistan after 9/11 and leading a team into Liberia during the 2014 Ebola outbreak.
After retiring, returned to Georgia to run a first-generation grass-fed cattle farm in Rockmart, in Polk County, according to his campaign website.
Was the Democratic nominee against incumbent Marjorie Taylor Greene in the 2024 general election, losing 64.4% to 35.6%.
Finished first in the March 10, 2026 special general election and lost the April 7 runoff to Clayton Fuller, 55.9% to 44.1%; won the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary for the regular election.
According to his campaign website, he and his wife, a family physician, have five sons and four grandchildren.
